run.boundary: Run counts are read from original receipts/results, not inferred from screenshots. Thisreviewdoesnotreverifythe servedbundle/buildclosure oreveryassertion.

captureMethod.Field: Originaltestcapture uses previewer.screenshot with the existing astro-dev-toolbar visibility style; these are locator-region captures, not full-page screenshots.
captureMethod.contactSheets: Pre-existingrootcontact sheets thumbnail the originalcaptures; surrounding gray is sheetbackground, not productblankness. No sheet or PNG was edited/reencoded here.

sheets.subject: Brutalist Button,4runtimes ×320px/100%and200%
observations: All8tiles contain the expected button demo; no all-blank/errorpage tile.
At100%, button groups are visible in rows, with runtime-tab text clipped at the right capture edge.

At200%, the column becomes extremely narrow with multi-line word/letter wrapping. A site Header strip crosses the column; the Mint area is not visible and the upper Lavender region is obscured. Originalindex2 confirms the occlusion.
sheets.limits: A frozen capture cannot establish whether a focused target was obscured during input, hit testing, fullpageoverflow or exact visible geometry.

sheets.subject: Base Field,4runtimes ×light/dark-narrow-200
observations: All8tiles contain Field sections rather than a blank/errorpage.
Light tiles show account/availability/owner-invalid/read-only/disabled/long-label sections. A navigation/header strip crosses the early portion of the captured preview.
Narrowdark tiles are heavily scaled down; Header is visible at the top and the text/control areas are difficult to assess at thumbnail scale.
sheets.limits: No exact readability, labelassociation, focus, contrast or right-edgegeometry is certified by the contact sheet.

sheets.subject: Bootstrap2.3.2 Field,4runtimes ×light/dark-narrow-200
observations: All8tiles contain Field sections, inputs and buttons; none is an obvious startup/errorpage.
The narrow captures form a very tall white content column beneath dark sitechrome, with heavy text wrapping. This is observed appearance, not a new theme-correctness verdict.
The light tiles show a header/navigation strip crossing an early Field area; controls and text outside the small tile are not fully assessable.
sheets.limits: No palette-equivalence or completecontrolvisibility verdict; thumbnails do not prove dimensions or offscreencontent.

sheets.subject: Brutalist Field,4runtimes ×light/dark-narrow-200
observations: All8tiles contain the blue/light or dark Field demo with outlined controls.
The light Header band visibly covers the region between the first Field help and availability editor; originalindex26 confirms the band and partial editor edge.
Narrowdark tiles show substantial right-edge text/control truncation at capture boundaries.
sheets.limits: Visiblecaptureocclusion is not evidence of the originalnativeclick target or a newrouterregression; no fullpagehorizontaloverflow is inferred.

sheets.subject: LiquidGlass Field,4runtimes ×light/dark-narrow-200
observations: All8tiles contain the Field demo over the patterned live backdrop; no blank/errorpage.
Backdrop words and diagonal bands compete visibly with foreground labels/help/status. Originalindex34 confirms overlapping text layers.
A Header band crosses the light capture and obscures the availability area. The narrowdark captures remain a very thin, dense column.
sheets.limits: No opticalquality/materialcorrectness/contrast conclusion; no newcausal attribution to the keyboard-owner condition.

sheets.subject: Shadcn Field,4runtimes ×light/dark-narrow-200
observations: All8tiles contain the expected Field sections and visible owner-invalid error content.
Narrowdark captures visibly cut long labels, editor values and action text at the right image edge; originalindex41 confirms extensive clipping.
Originalindex41 also shows the top Header covering part of the account label. Light tiles have the corresponding navigation band across the early part of the preview.
sheets.limits: Imageboundaries may reflect locatorcapture/viewport limits. No pageoverflow amount, keyboardfocusocclusion or AT result is inferred.
